title: eu-web-compliance: one finding
description: One finding of the unified compliance report, normalised from the report of one checker (check-a11y, check-privacy, check-security, check-content). A finding is a non-conformity (NC) or an item a person must review (NT). It never states that anything conforms.

id.description: Stable key of the finding inside one report: domain, rule, page and element joined by '|'. The same key in two reports means the same finding (used for 'what changed').

domain.description: Domain of the obligation: accessibility, privacy (data protection and trackers), ai (AI Act), security, consumer (consumer and information law).

detector.description: Part of the checker that raised it (axe, runtime, catalogue, headers, page...), as given by the checker.

rule.description: Rule identifier of the checker (axe rule id, anti-pattern id such as AP-FRM-01, or checker rule such as third-party-request-before-consent).

verdict.description: NC: non-conformity found by the code. NT: not decided by the tool, a person must review it.

severity.description: Priority: blocking (prevents access or exposes to a direct sanction), major (serious difficulty or risk, can be worked around), minor (degradation without blocking).

sources.description: Texts the rule comes from, one per item (for example 'WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3', 'RGAA 4.1.2 criterion 3.2', 'ePrivacy art. 5(3)'). Empty only when the checker gave none.

source_ids.description: Identifiers of those sources in references/sources.json, when the checker gives them.

page.description: Page checked: path relative to the site folder, or the URL.

element.description: Short description of the element concerned, used for grouping and comparison: the CSS selector, else the header, cookie, storage item, request host or file and line. Null when the finding concerns the page as a whole.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element in the rendered page.

request.description: Network request concerned (third-party request, insecure sub-resource).

storage.description: Browser storage item concerned (localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB).

file.description: Source file where a pattern was found (catalogue and secret detectors).

detail.description: Extra detail given by the checker (header value, directive, attribute).

message.description: What was found, in the words of the checker.

impact.description: Who is affected and how, when the checker gives an impact sentence; null otherwise.

fix_ref.description: Reference file of the skill that explains how to fix it (path relative to the skill root), when one exists for this rule; null otherwise.

fix_entry.description: Entry to read in fix_ref (anti-pattern id), when known.

help_url.description: External help page given by the checker (axe-core rule description).
